div.head: Ps Cn for 3.1
div.ab: Mediocresque tales post ferarum curam susceptam pro liberalibus semper habeantur, quos Dani ealdermen appellant.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 621 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: And let such middling men, after they have taken on the care of the beasts, always be held as nobles, whom the Danes call ealdermen.
